> # Australia Critical Minerals Production Tax Incentive
>
> ## 원문 보존
>
> - 원문: https://www.industry.gov.au/mining-oil-and-gas/minerals/critical-minerals/critical-minerals-production-tax-incentive
> - 접근 상태: Vercel 공개 배포의 보관 원문을 복구한 기록입니다.
>
> ### 보관된 원문 요약
>
> The Australian Government states that the Critical Minerals Production Tax Incentive will be available from 1 July 2027 to 30 June 2040. It provides a refundable, uncapped tax offset equal to 10% of eligible Australian processing and refining expenditure for up to ten years per registered activity. Eligible activities must substantially transform a feedstock into a purer or chemically distinct critical-mineral form. Mining, beneficiation, manufacturing, feedstock cost, financing cost, and capital expenditure are excluded. Eligible feedstock may include imported ore, concentrates, tailings, waste streams, and lithium-battery black mass.
>
> This source note preserves facts stated on the official Department of Industry, Science and Resources page. Project-specific eligibility and cash value require separate tax and cost review.
